text:
The tool output covers 2025, not 2026, so I can't confirm anything for 2026. The series ends in 2025 (latest observed year), and the evidence was compiled on 2026-11-12.

For 2025, Hansen/UMD maps about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss (3.91% of the 345.6 ha property). JRC data shows 98% of that area was forest in 2020. The MGAP 2021 map classifies about 13.1 ha as native forest and none as planted.

Caveats:
- The status is pending corroboration. 2025 is the latest year, so no later year confirms persistence.
- The data doesn't establish deforestation (Hansen loss includes any stand replacement), nor the cause, legality, or who was responsible.

To answer for 2026, you'd need the next annual update of the series.
